summary.text: Kimberly Edwards is the Democratic state representative for Michigan House District 12, which she has held since January 1, 2023, and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.
Ballotpedia, which lists her as Kimberly L. Edwards, says she was born in Detroit, lives in Eastpointe, and has worked as a social worker.

paragraphs.text: Kimberly Edwards took office in the state House in 2023, succeeding Democrat Alex Garza, who held District 12 before her.
